products.name: Duolingo
products.key_insight: Duolingo is a masterclass in habit formation mechanics but struggles with the transition from extrinsic hooks to intrinsic motivation. The streak counter keeps users opening the app, but 'opening the app' ≠ 'learning a language.' Products that confuse engagement metrics with outcome metrics eventually face this tension.
products.top_technique: Streak Mechanics as Loss Aversion Engine
